full_judgment: 57. We do strongly disapprove of this type of unfounded submission advanced by the learned Advocate for the opposite party No. 3 rather it is our considered view that by now it is fairly settled by a good number of authorities that the onus to prove fraud or material suppression of facts is squarely upon the party who alleges it and a registered document has a presumption of correctness under clause (e) of section 114 of the Evidence Act, 1872.
